lines.text: Compare the new itinerary before accepting it, then check airport transport, connections, hotel arrival and other bookings against the revised times.

items.text: Save the original and revised itinerary, notification time, booking reference and any response deadline.
Compare dates, local times, airports, connections, operating carriers and cabin, not only the departure hour.
Ask about alternatives and applicable refund options before selecting accept, credit or cancellation.

line.text: Record the change and it walks down everything you said was booked around it, one booking at a time, editing nothing for you.
